messages:
alex_chen: Prototype rolled into staging: per-tenant amortized cache-credit view in the cost dashboard is up. Quick link: https://staging.console.redwood/costs/amortized?env=staging — please poke, especially around how credits display when routing falls back.
mina_patel: Nice. Quick Q: how are we splitting credits between prefix/KV hits and full-response cache? Sticky routing + fallbacks make attribution fuzzy.
jorge: We landed a simple heuristic in the prototype. Short version: prefix KV savings go to the visible route id; fallback-induced savings are amortized across candidate routes based on token-cost delta and recent routing weights. Pasting simplified logic: 
```
# credit allocation (simplified)
if kv_hit:
  credit[route] += kv_saved_tokens * unit_cost
elif fallback_model:
  credit_split = proportional(token_cost_delta, route_weights)
```
tara_ng: UX note: right now per-tenant line sometimes shows a negative "net cost" which confused support in demo. Suggest showing "Cache savings" as a separate column/stack and leaving "Billed tokens" as gross. Tooltip can explain net = gross - savings.
alex_chen: Good call. Current design computes net_cost = billed_token_cost - cache_credit. Tara: want to add a toggle (gross / net) + a tiny sparkline and hover breakdown by credit source (KV vs response).
mina_patel: Also would like an alert when amortized credits shift >20% day-over-day for a tenant — we saw rollouts cause big swings previously.
jorge: We can add alerts but watch sampling noise. Our sampling layer is 5% by default for high-volume tenants. Suggest detecting sustained change (e.g., 95th-percentile rolling window over 6h) rather than a single-day spike.
cost-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed for feature/cache-crediting v0.3 to staging (build 2026.03.20-14).
alex_chen: Action items: @mina_patel to draft alert thresholds and noise-handling, @tara_ng to mock gross/net toggle and tooltip, @jorge to add deterministic attribution tests + document the heuristic in the repo. I'll follow up with a short RFC doc and add it to the rollout checklist.
tara_ng: :thumbsup: will have mocks by EOD tomorrow.
mina_patel: I'll open a PR in ops-alerts with a tenant-scoped alert option. Quick question: should alerts default to tenant-scoped or org-wide? Tenant-scoped is more targeted but will generate more alerts.
jorge: Lean tenant-scoped with grouping by billing account, plus an umbrella org-level check that surfaces only when >X% of tenants hit the threshold. Also add a debug link that pre-populates the query with the tenant id.
alex_chen: Also flag: ensure unit_cost used for amortization is tied to model-catalog SKU and tracked across quantized/model variant changes; if unit_cost drifts we'll mis-attribute savings.
mina_patel: :eyes: I'll add a delta-check comparing catalog unit_cost vs runtime estimators and fire an internal alert if >10% mismatch.
alex_chen: Thanks everyone. Tagging @product-yas for visibility on rollout messaging and billing docs. We'll capture these action items in the RFC.
product-yas: thanks for the ping — will sync with billing docs and customer comms after RFC is posted.
